column1: # Review C §3.2 item 1 (API_1.0.md §2.3): the kind that replaces each variant of today's `SymplexError` enum.  Hand-written.
# Columns: variant, kind, mark, ctor, ctor_fields
#   mark = yes  the rewritten line gets a `// codemod(errors): was <variant>` marker: the default successor is
#               `Undetermined`, and the raise site may be classified otherwise by packages E2b-E2d
#   ctor / ctor_fields  rule errors.construct (library code, `--src-code`): the struct literal
#               EMPTY = no constructor is named in the design: the literal is listed, not rewritten.
#               Package E1 adds a constructor per kind and must fill in or correct this column before using the rule.
